purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 5-record item effect batch 025; together these files contain exactly 5 self-contained reviewed records.

items/pipes-of-frenzied-revelry-631.name: Pipes of Frenzied Revelry [Relic]
items/pipes-of-frenzied-revelry-631.effectSummary: A chaotic-neutral, neutral, chaotic-good, or chaotic-evil player gains +5 competence on Perform (wind instruments). With the relic connection to Olidammara, each round of playing can use a DC 25 Perform check; on success, every living creature within 30 feet must make Will DC 16 or suffer a confusion-like effect while the piping continues and remains within range, except results that would attack another creature instead cause a mildly amorous advance. Playing costs a standard action each round. Interruption or resuming after a failed Perform check permits new saves, and a creature that successfully saves is immune for 24 hours.

items/rod-absorption-194.name: Rod of Absorption
items/rod-absorption-194.effectSummary: While held, the rod automatically absorbs and nullifies a single-target spell, ray, or spell-like ability directed at the wielder or their gear, with no action required, and stores energy equal to the effect's spell level. The wielder immediately knows the absorbed spell's level and can spend stored levels to cast prepared spells without expending their preparation, or known spells for spontaneous casters, provided enough stored levels are spent and normal material components are supplied. A rod can absorb at most 50 spell levels over its lifetime, cannot be recharged, and after reaching that limit can only discharge remaining stored energy; its wielder knows both remaining absorption capacity and currently stored energy.
